item.title: 8th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals Digest: Feb. 25, 2026
item.description: These opinions were released by the 8th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals.

item.title: Supreme Court Digest: Feb. 25, 2026
item.description: These opinions were released by the Minnesota Supreme Court.

item.title: ‘Undecided’ leads in Wisconsin Supreme Court race, poll shows
item.description: Wisconsin Supreme Court candidate Chris Taylor leads Maria Lazar by 5 points, but 66% of voters remain undecided ahead of the April 7 election.

item.title: Minnesota AG probes 200+ providers in Medicaid fraud cases
item.description: Minnesota Attorney General's Office is investigating more than 200 providers for Medicaid fraud amid federal funding withholdings and political disputes.

item.title: Judge: IRS broke law ‘approximately 42,695 times’ in giving DHS data
item.description: A federal judge ruled the IRS violated law thousands of times by improperly sharing taxpayer addresses with DHS immigration officials.

item.title: Court of Appeals orders paternity test in adoption case
item.description: Minnesota Court of Appeals orders genetic testing after ruling a district court wrongly blocked a putative father’s effort to establish paternity.

item.title: Justices uphold murder verdict, differ on reasoning
item.description: The Minnesota Supreme Court affirmed Nicholas Firkus’ first-degree murder conviction, issuing a divided ruling on circumstantial evidence standards.

item.title: Justice Department sues five more states over voter registration lists
item.description: The U.S. Justice Department sued Utah, Oklahoma, Kentucky, West Virginia, and New Jersey for failing to provide full voter registration lists, raising the total sued states to 29.

item.title: Kansas invalidates IDs and birth certificates of transgender people
item.description: The American Civil Liberties Union and Ballard Spahr LLP have filed a lawsuit challenging the law.

item.title: Applications sought for 1st District judicial vacancy
item.description: The application process is now open for a vacancy in the 1st Judicial District. This seat will be chambered in Shakopee in Scott County.
